name: getFlagStars
description: Returns whether stars are currently displayed in the sky.
returnDescription: true if stars are visible, false if hidden

name: setFlagStars
description: Shows or hides all stars in the sky.

parameters.name: visible
parameters.description: true to show stars, false to hide

name: getFlagLabels
description: Returns whether star labels (names) are currently displayed.
returnDescription: true if star labels are visible, false if hidden

name: setFlagLabels
description: Shows or hides star labels (names).

parameters.name: visible
parameters.description: true to show labels, false to hide

name: getLabelsAmount
description: Returns the amount of star labels displayed. Higher values show labels for fainter stars.
example:
var labelsAmount = StarMgr.getLabelsAmount();
core.debug("Star labels amount: " + labelsAmount);

name: setLabelsAmount
description: Sets the amount of star labels displayed. 0 = no labels, 10 = maximum labels (shows labels for faintest stars).

name: getFlagSciNames
description: Returns whether scientific star names (Bayer/Flamsteed designations) are displayed for stars without common names.
returnDescription: true if scientific names are shown

name: setFlagSciNames
description: Sets whether scientific star names (Bayer/Flamsteed designations) are displayed for stars without common names.

name: getFlagAdditionalNames
description: Returns whether additional star names (aliases) are displayed in the information panel.
returnDescription: true if additional names are shown

name: setFlagAdditionalNames
description: Shows or hides additional star names (aliases) in the information panel.

name: getDesignationUsage
description: Returns whether catalog designations are used instead of common names for star labels.
returnDescription: true if designations are preferred over common names

name: setDesignationUsage
description: Sets whether catalog designations should be used instead of common names for star labels.

name: getFlagDblStarsDesignation
description: Returns whether traditional designations for double stars are displayed.
returnDescription: true if double star designations are shown

name: setFlagDblStarsDesignation
description: Shows or hides traditional designations for double stars (e.g., 'α1 Cen', 'ε1 Lyr').

parameters.name: show
parameters.description: true to show double star designations

name: getFlagVarStarsDesignation
description: Returns whether variable star designations (GCVS names) are displayed.
returnDescription: true if variable star designations are shown

name: setFlagVarStarsDesignation
description: Shows or hides variable star designations (GCVS names like 'RR Lyr', 'δ Cep').

parameters.name: show
parameters.description: true to show variable star designations

name: getFlagHIPDesignation
description: Returns whether Hipparcos catalog numbers are displayed for stars.
returnDescription: true if HIP numbers are shown

name: setFlagHIPDesignation
description: Shows or hides Hipparcos catalog numbers for stars.

name: increaseStarsMagnitudeLimit
description: Increases the custom star magnitude limit by 0.1 magnitude, showing fainter stars.

name: reduceStarsMagnitudeLimit
description: Reduces the custom star magnitude limit by 0.1 magnitude, showing only brighter stars.
example:
// Show only brighter stars
StarMgr.reduceStarsMagnitudeLimit();

name: searchHP
description: Searches for a star by its Hipparcos catalog number.
returnDescription: Star object, or null if not found

name: searchGaia
description: Searches for a star by its Gaia DR3 source ID.
returnDescription: Star object, or null if not found

name: searchByID
description: Searches for a star by its identifier (HIP, SAO, HD, HR, GCVS, WDS, or common name).
returnDescription: Star object, or null if not found

name: searchByNameI18n
description: Searches for a star by its translated (localized) name.
returnDescription: Star object, or null if not found
example: var sirius = StarMgr.searchByNameI18n(StarMgr.getCommonNameI18n(32349));

name: searchByName
description: Searches for a star by its English name or catalog number.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: English star name or catalog number

returnDescription: Star object, or null if not found
example:
var betelgeuse = StarMgr.searchByName("Betelgeuse");
var polaris = StarMgr.searchByName("Polaris");

name: getCommonEnglishName
description: Returns the English common name for a star by its Hipparcos or Gaia catalog number (e.g., 'Sirius', 'Betelgeuse').
returnDescription: English common name, or empty string if none

name: getCommonNameI18n
description: Returns the translated common name for a star by its Hipparcos or Gaia catalog number.
example:
var translatedName = StarMgr.getCommonNameI18n(32349);
core.debug("Sirius in current language: " + translatedName);

name: getCulturalNames
description: Returns the cultural names for a star (native names from different sky cultures).

name: getCulturalScreenLabel
description: Returns the screen label for a star based on the current sky culture settings (short format).
example:
var screenLabel = StarMgr.getCulturalScreenLabel(32349);
core.debug("Star label: " + screenLabel);

name: getCulturalInfoLabel
description: Returns the information label for a star based on the current sky culture settings (long format for info panel).
example:
var infoLabel = StarMgr.getCulturalInfoLabel(32349);
core.debug("Star info: " + infoLabel);

name: getSciDesignation
description: Returns the scientific designation (Bayer/Flamsteed name) for a star (e.g., 'α CMa', '21 Tau').
example:
var sciName = StarMgr.getSciDesignation(32349);
core.debug("Sirius scientific name: " + sciName); // 'α CMa'

name: getSciExtraDesignation
description: Returns additional scientific designations for a star (e.g., double star or variable star designations).
example:
var extraName = StarMgr.getSciExtraDesignation(32349);
core.debug("Extra designations: " + extraName);

name: getCrossIdentificationDesignations
description: Returns cross-identification designations (SAO, HD, HR numbers) for a star.
example:
var crossIds = StarMgr.getCrossIdentificationDesignations("32349");
core.debug("Cross IDs: " + crossIds); // 'HR 2491 - HD 48915'

name: convertToSpectralType
description: Converts a spectral type index to a human-readable spectral type string (e.g., 'G2V', 'M5III').

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Spectral type index from star catalog

name: convertToComponentIds
description: Converts a component index to a letter suffix (A, B, C, etc.) for double star components.
example:
var component = StarMgr.convertToComponentIds(1);
core.debug("Component: " + component); // 'A'

name: convertToOjectTypes
description: Converts an object type index to a human-readable object type description.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Object type index from star catalog

example:
var objType = StarMgr.convertToOjectTypes(someIndex);
core.debug("Object type: " + objType);

name: getHipparcosStars
description: Returns a list of all Hipparcos stars loaded in Stellarium.
example:
var hipparcosList = StarMgr.getHipparcosStars();
core.debug("Number of Hipparcos stars: " + hipparcosList.length);

name: getHipparcosDoubleStars
description: Returns a list of Hipparcos double stars with their separations.
returnDescription: List of double star objects with separations

name: getHipparcosVariableStars
description: Returns a list of Hipparcos variable stars with their periods.
returnDescription: List of variable star objects with periods

name: getHipparcosAlgolTypeStars
description: Returns a list of Algol-type eclipsing binary stars.
example:
var algolStars = StarMgr.getHipparcosAlgolTypeStars();
core.debug("Number of Algol-type stars: " + algolStars.length);

name: getHipparcosClassicalCepheidsTypeStars
description: Returns a list of classical Cepheid variable stars.

name: getHipparcosCarbonStars
description: Returns a list of carbon stars (red giants with carbon-rich atmospheres).

name: getHipparcosBariumStars
description: Returns a list of barium stars (G/K giants with enhanced barium).
example:
var bariumStars = StarMgr.getHipparcosBariumStars();
core.debug("Barium stars count: " + bariumStars.length);

name: getHipparcosHighPMStars
description: Returns a list of stars with high proper motion (>1000 mas/year).
returnDescription: List of high proper motion stars with velocities

name: getCatalogsDescription
description: Returns the list of star catalog descriptions (file names, checksums, enabled status).

name: getStelObjectType
description: Returns the object type string for stars ('Star').
example:
var objType = StarMgr.getStelObjectType();
core.debug("Object type: " + objType); // 'Star'

name: getName
description: Returns the display name of the Star Manager module.
example:
var moduleName = StarMgr.getName();
core.debug("Module: " + moduleName); // 'Stars'

name: getGcvsDesignation
description: Returns the GCVS (General Catalogue of Variable Stars) designation for a variable star.
example:
var gcvs = StarMgr.getGcvsDesignation(95497);
core.debug("Variable star designation: " + gcvs); // 'RR Lyr'

name: getGcvsVariabilityType
description: Returns the variability type of a variable star (e.g., 'RRAB', 'DCEP', 'EA').
example:
var varType = StarMgr.getGcvsVariabilityType(95497);
core.debug("Variability type: " + varType);

name: getGcvsMaxMagnitude
description: Returns the maximum magnitude (brightest) of a variable star.
example:
var maxMag = StarMgr.getGcvsMaxMagnitude(95497);
core.debug("RR Lyr max magnitude: " + maxMag);

name: getGcvsMinMagnitude
description: Returns the minimum magnitude (faintest) of a variable star. For Algol-type stars, can get first or second minimum.

parameters.name: firstMinimumFlag
parameters.description: If true, returns first minimum; if false, returns second minimum

example:
var minMag = StarMgr.getGcvsMinMagnitude(95497);
core.debug("RR Lyr min magnitude: " + minMag);

name: getGcvsPeriod
description: Returns the period of a variable star in days.
example:
var period = StarMgr.getGcvsPeriod(95497);
core.debug("RR Lyr period: " + period + " days");

name: getGcvsEpoch
description: Returns the epoch for maximum light of a variable star in Julian Days.
example:
var epoch = StarMgr.getGcvsEpoch(95497);
core.debug("Maximum light epoch: " + epoch);

name: getGcvsPhotometricSystem
description: Returns the photometric system used for magnitude measurements of a variable star.
example:
var photosys = StarMgr.getGcvsPhotometricSystem(95497);
core.debug("Photometric system: " + photosys);

name: getGcvsSpectralType
description: Returns the spectral type of a variable star from GCVS data.
example:
var spec = StarMgr.getGcvsSpectralType(95497);
core.debug("Spectral type: " + spec);

name: getGcvsMagnitudeFlag
description: Returns the magnitude flag code for a variable star.
example:
var flag = StarMgr.getGcvsMagnitudeFlag(95497);
core.debug("Magnitude flag: " + flag);

name: getGcvsMM
description: Returns the rising time or duration of eclipse for a variable star in percent.
example:
var mm = StarMgr.getGcvsMM(14576); // Algol
core.debug("Eclipse duration: " + mm + "%");

name: getWdsDesignation
description: Returns the Washington Double Star (WDS) catalog designation for a double star.
example:
var wds = StarMgr.getWdsDesignation(95947); // Albireo
core.debug("WDS designation: " + wds);

name: getWdsLastObservation
description: Returns the year of the last satisfactory observation of a double star.
example:
var lastObs = StarMgr.getWdsLastObservation(95947);
core.debug("Last observation: " + lastObs);

name: getWdsLastPositionAngle
description: Returns the position angle (in degrees) of a double star at the last observation.
example:
var pa = StarMgr.getWdsLastPositionAngle(95947);
core.debug("Position angle: " + pa + "°");

name: getWdsLastSeparation
description: Returns the separation (in arcseconds) of a double star at the last observation.
example:
var sep = StarMgr.getWdsLastSeparation(95947);
core.debug("Separation: " + sep + " arcsec");

name: getBinaryOrbitData
description: Returns binary orbit parameters for a binary star system (period, eccentricity, inclination, masses, etc.).
